# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 24 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## NDR 2026: Public Housing Income Ceilings Raised

- **BTO income ceiling lifted to S$16,000; EC ceiling raised to S$18,000** - PM Lawrence Wong announced at the National Day Rally on 23 August that the HDB BTO income ceiling for families rises to S$16,000 (singles to S$8,000), and the EC ceiling climbs to S$18,000, effective 24 August 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ndr-2026-bto-income-ceiling-raised-to-s16000-ec-ceiling-to-s18000/)

- **Buyer explainer on the new income ceiling changes** - Stacked Homes breaks down what the revised BTO and EC income ceilings mean for different buyer profiles, including the singles sub-ceiling of S$8,000. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-raises-income-ceiling-to-16k-and-ec-ceiling-to-18k/)

## Private Market: Sales, Rentals & Supply

- **New private home sales rebound to 3-month high in July 2026** - Developers sold 731 new private homes (excluding ECs) in July 2026, up 368.6% from June's 156 units, marking the strongest sales month since April 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-home-sales-rebound-to-3-month-high-as-july-launches-return/)

- **Condo rental prices and volumes both hit all-time highs in July 2026** - Singapore's condo rental market recorded simultaneous record highs in both rental prices and transaction volumes in July 2026, with the HDB rental market also strengthening in the same month. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-rental-prices-volumes-record-high-july-2026/)

- **Up to 2,550 private homes proposed for Kallang Distripark site** - URA published proposed Master Plan amendments on 14 August 2026 that could convert the existing Kallang Distripark industrial site into a private housing precinct of up to 2,550 homes near Geylang Bahru MRT. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/kallang-distripark-redevelopment-private-homes/)

## HDB Resale: Record Transactions

- **Clementi Peaks 3-room flat sets new town resale record at S$896,000** - A unit at Clementi Peaks changed hands for S$896,000, a new record for Clementi's 3-room HDB resale market, transacted before the development reached its Minimum Occupation Period. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/clementi-peaks-first-resale-breaks-3rm-hdb-record-at-s896k/)

- **58-year-old Queenstown HDB terrace house sells for record S$1.04 million** - A rare HDB terrace house at Stirling Road, Queenstown sold for S$1.04 million — a new record for the most expensive 3-room flat by absolute price in the town — with around 40 years of lease remaining. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/58-year-old-hdb-terrace-house-in-queenstown-sells-for-record-s1-04m/)
